therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: PD-L1 checkpoint inhibition combined with VEGF-mediated angiogenesis inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation and tumor vasculature normalization
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic mucosal melanoma

results.dose_information: Atezolizumab 1200 mg IV every 3 weeks; Bevacizumab 7.5 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks
